term: maximum in an order with a cause-of-degree relation
definition: System stores a cause-of-degree relation on a Mathlib preorder. IsMax means that no member is strictly greater (maximal, not necessarily greatest). CausesRaiseDegree separately requires each distinct cause to be strictly greater than its effect. A maximum need not exist, be unique, cause anything, or be God. Only distinct causes of the same chosen degree are excluded by the schema theorem.
note: A mathematical interface for conditional instances, not a reading of Aquinas or a definition of causation. The domain-specific interpretation is retained by perfectionOrderSystem; the homogeneous representation and causal ascent are additional conditional hypotheses.
